info.title: Application onboarding setup
info.description: Implemented local setup contract. This optional capability is not deployed by this artifact. The setup routes mount only when the protected onboarding server policy and mTLS provisioner are configured; verification also requires a per-application verifier grant.

get.x-required-access: SUPER_ADMIN with current database-backed authorization; no implicit business grant.
get.description: Returns scoped setup readiness and a strong setup ETag. Readiness is a snapshot; it is not proof of live provider permission or device delivery.

get.x-required-access: SUPER_ADMIN with current database-backed authorization; no implicit business grant.
get.description: Returns the operator-approved enrollment profiles configured in the protected server policy.

get.x-required-access: SUPER_ADMIN with current database-backed authorization; no implicit business grant.
get.description: Returns a sanitized operation scoped to this application. An operation from another application returns 404.

get.x-required-access: SUPER_ADMIN with current database-backed authorization; no implicit business grant.
get.description: Lists existing safe approval metadata. This API has no approval-issuance route.

put.summary: Select enrollment profile and platform identifiers
put.x-required-access: SUPER_ADMIN with current database-backed authorization; no implicit business grant. Existing campaign grant/send permission applies to dispatch.
put.description: Stores an allowlisted enrollment profile and platform identifiers. This does not activate the application. Writes require If-Match and Idempotency-Key. Enrollment, FCM staging, and hold replay records expire after 24 hours.

put.x-required-access: SUPER_ADMIN with current database-backed authorization; no implicit business grant. Existing campaign grant/send permission applies to dispatch.
put.description: Stages a validated FCM service-account candidate through the protected mTLS provisioner and returns metadata only. It does not make the candidate current or prove IAM permission or device delivery. Writes require If-Match and Idempotency-Key. Enrollment, FCM staging, and hold replay records expire after 24 hours. The total JSON body limit is 96 KiB; the nested service-account object limit is 64 KiB.

post.x-required-access: SUPER_ADMIN with current database-backed authorization; no implicit business grant. Existing campaign grant/send permission applies to dispatch.

202.description: Verification operation queued; repeated keys return the retained operation.

429.description: Per-application limit of five new verification jobs per minute; Retry-After is 60 seconds.

503.description: Per-application verifier is not configured or same-application target-permission dry-run is not implemented; Retry-After is 5 seconds.

post.description: Queues OAuth-only verification for a current or candidate configuration. It does not prove Firebase target IAM permission or device delivery. At most five new verification jobs per application are accepted per minute. A valid same-application test_installation_id currently returns 503 until dry-run support is implemented; a foreign installation returns 404. Explicit null is invalid. Other setup write bodies are limited to 64 KiB.

post.x-required-access: SUPER_ADMIN with current database-backed authorization; no implicit business grant. Existing campaign grant/send permission applies to dispatch.
post.description: Synchronously places dispatch in HELD. This does not change application lifecycle status or issue a release. Writes require If-Match and Idempotency-Key. Enrollment, FCM staging, and hold replay records expire after 24 hours.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Required strong setup ETag from the latest readiness or mutation response, formatted as "onboarding:{app_id}:{revision}".

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required canonical UUID. Same actor/application/operation and payload replays the stored result; a changed payload with the same key conflicts.

checks.description: Latest evidence for checks_configuration_id. Missing LOCAL_FORMAT, OAUTH, TARGET_PERMISSION and DEVICE_DELIVERY checks are explicitly NOT_CHECKED with null timestamps. OAuth success alone proves neither target permission nor device reception.

checks_configuration_id.description: Configuration evaluated by checks: candidate when present, otherwise current. Candidate evidence does not attest the active configuration.

private_key.description: Write-only key material. Never include a real credential in documentation examples.

ServiceAccount.description: Strict Google service-account JSON. The credential is write-only and is sent only to the protected provisioner over mTLS; it is never returned by these routes.

test_installation_id.description: Optional public installation UUID. Explicit null is invalid. A valid installation owned by this application currently returns 503 because target-permission dry-run is not implemented; a foreign installation returns 404.
